items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Juan Tizol in relation to Rosebud; the entire context discusses the naming history of the interviewee (who is identified as Rosebud/Rose in the text, despite the label saying Juan Tizol, the content is clearly from an interview with Mercer Ellington or similar,

ctx.x: No, I mean did you hear that?
Oh, yeah. We'll pick it up. She spoke loudly enough. There was something I want to know. Is your name Rose or is it Rosebud?

I was born Rosebud, and then they changed -- I changed it. All my family called me Bud, and everybody I knew in Washington, D.C., for a long time, called me Bud. That's how Duke Ellington got to calling me Rosebud; he always called me Rosebud.
